title: Spring Day in my Rural Cottage Life
en: you picking wildflowers is a passion of mine they are so abundant here that making a little bouquet is a seasonal treat that I look forward to all year you see I live in a very rural part of Washington state and the local wildflowers are mostly undisturbed by humans I'm also happy to say they're visited often by the bees I always try to be conscious when I forage seeking the most abundant places not picking more than a couple flowers in one spot I ask for permission to take bounty reassuring nature that I will cherish her work and that she will not have to share more than the smallest portion you I think using this method is an excellent philosophy for life consume carefully and consciously and appreciate

the wonder and beauty of what you have as humans we often take more than we need not being able to imagine a life where shopping and traveling isn't a priority but it is possible and I find that much satisfaction can come from it that is my secret I will see you guys next time consider subscribing if you enjoyed this video have a lovely day
zh: 你采摘野花是我的爱好，这里的野花如此丰富，以至于制作一束小花束是一种季节性的享受，我一年四季都盼望着你看，我住在华盛顿州的一个非常乡村的地方，当地的野花大多没有受到人类的干扰，我也很高兴地说，它们经常被蜜蜂拜访。会珍惜她的工作，她不会分享超过你的最小部分我认为使用这种方法是一种很好的生活哲学，仔细、有意识地消费和欣赏
作为人类，我们所拥有的奇迹和美丽常常超出了我们需要的范围，无法想象购物和旅行不是优先考虑的生活，但这是可能的，我发现从中可以获得很大的满足感，这是我的秘密，我下次再见，如果您喜欢这个视频，请考虑订阅，祝您度过愉快的一天
